description: This PHP file defines the class SuiteEditorDirectHTML, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface. It provides methods for setting up a simple HTML editor using Smarty templates in the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: SuiteEditorDirectHTML
classes.description: A class that implements SuiteEditorInterface to provide a simple textarea-based SuiteEditor utilizing Smarty templates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteEditorDirectHTML with optional settings via a SuiteEditorSettings object.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Fetches the HTML for the editor by assigning settings to Smarty and using a template.
